about: I am currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering at the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT), with professional experience in software development spanning game development, web and mobile applications, AI, and automation.

My journey began in game development, where I gained extensive experience working with Unity, C#, and 3D development tools. Over the years, I have developed and published multiple single-player and multiplayer games on the Google Play Store, gaining valuable experience in software architecture, debugging, performance optimization, and delivering complete applications.

As I broaden my focus into software engineering, I have expanded my technical expertise to include Python, Java, JavaScript, React, Flask, SQL, and other modern development tools and frameworks. As an SIT Scholar and an international hackathon winner, I strive to challenge myself, adapt to new technologies, and continuously improve as a developer.
I am particularly interested in opportunities involving software engineering, full-stack development, AI, and automation.
